Name: Dual Enkephalinase Inhibitor Effects on Stress-Induced Reward Seeking Neural and Behavioral Deficits
Description: This dataset contains the raw data from behavioral and fiber photometry recording sessions for the first phase of a study investigating the effects of a dual enkephalinase inhibitor on stress-induced deficits in reward-seeking behavior in mice.
